texts.en: One hundred years ago, we took to the stars. It was a new beginning for us, and for the Quest, with seemingly infinite opportunities opening to us. A century has passed, and our population feels divided. While our achievements are undeniable, there are voices doubting the purpose of the knights and the Quest. Are they just relics of a bygone age?

label.zh: 不。我们要举办一场庆典，纪念我们的骑士！
label.en: No. We'll hold a festival to honor our knights!

label.zh: 我们没时间理会这样的琐事。
label.en: We have no time for such trifles.

label.zh: 是。这是历经百年的一连串失败。必须将此事了结。
label.en: Yes. It was a century of failures. Put an end to this.

texts.zh: 主城沦陷了。许多珍贵的战利品和古董被强盗们洗劫一空。然而，在撤离的一片混乱中，仍然有几名勇敢的骑士成功守住了我们宝贵的研究成果，将文库封印到了一个秘密的房室里面。它们现在应该安全了，但是如果无法直接读取这些只是，我们的骑士团就无法运作。
texts.en: The Keep is lost. Many precious trophies and relics have been taken by looters. However, in the chaos of the evacuation, several brave knights managed to preserve our precious research by sealing the archives within a secret chamber. They should be safe for now, but without direct access to this knowledge, the Order cannot function.

texts.zh: 主城沦陷了。许多珍贵的战利品和古董被强盗们洗劫一空。然而，在撤离的一片混乱中，仍然有几名勇敢的骑士成功守住了我们宝贵的研究成果，将文库封印到了一个秘密的房室里面。它们现在应该安全了，但是如果无法直接读取这些只是，试炼就无法继续进行。
texts.en: The Keep is lost. Many precious trophies and relics have been taken by looters. However, in the chaos of the evacuation, several brave knights managed to preserve our precious research by sealing the archives within a secret chamber. They should be safe for now, but without direct access to this knowledge, the quest cannot continue.

label.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价夺回那处居住站！
label.en: We must retake the habitat at all costs!

title.en: The Destruction of the Order's Keep

texts.zh: 骑士团主城被毁了，仅剩一大堆浮动的残骸。骑士领主已经死亡，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。文库被洗劫一空。损失是不可估量的。仅剩的少许剩余的骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
texts.en: The Keep has been destroyed, reduced to a mass of floating debris. The Lord Commander is dead, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been obliterated. This loss is immeasurable. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

texts.zh: 骑士团主城被毁了，仅剩一大堆浮动的残骸。骑士领主已经死亡，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。文库被洗劫一空。损失是不可估量的。在这一切发生之后，我们再也没有办法继续誓言试炼了。仅剩的少许剩余的骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
texts.en: The Keep has been destroyed, reduced to a mass of floating debris. The Lord Commander is dead, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been obliterated. This loss is immeasurable. There is no way that we can continue the quest after this. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

texts.zh: 骑士团主城隔绝开了，化为了一座浮空的纪念碑。骑士领主已经永远离去，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。与宝库也失去了联系。损失难以估量。硕果仅存的少许骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
texts.en: The Keep has been sealed off from us, reduced to a floating mausoleum. The Lord Commander is forever lost, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been disconnected. This loss is immeasurable. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

texts.zh: 骑士团主城隔绝开了，化为了一座浮空的纪念碑。骑士领主已经永远离去，一同追随而去的还有绝大多数的骑士和扈从。与宝库也失去了联系。损失难以估量。从此以往我们再也不可能继续试炼了。硕果仅存的少许骑士被召回。骑士团的未来注定走向灭亡。
texts.en: The Keep has been sealed off from us, reduced to a floating mausoleum. The Lord Commander is forever lost, along with most of our knights and squires. The archives have been disconnected. This loss is immeasurable. There is no way that we can continue the quest after this. The handful of surviving knights have been recalled. The future of the Order lies in ruin.

title.en: The Fate of the Toxic God

texts.zh:
在找到了有毒实体后，我们的骑士们失去了毒圣去向的行踪。这两者的关联毋庸置疑，但如果要相信我们的历史档案，那么这个实体与智慧和强大的毒圣原体相比可就相形见绌了。

无论如何，我们寻找毒圣的旅途在今天结束了。我们已经从星系中心的超大质量黑洞中发现了排出的痕量有毒物质。尽管看起来不可思议，但我们确信毒圣就在那儿，但远超我们的能力所及。

骑士领主命令所有骑士全力以赴取得任何与黑洞有关的东西，但成功的希望很小。
texts.en:
After finding the Toxic Entity, our knights lost the trail of the Toxic God. The connection between the two is unquestionable, but if the archives are to be believed, the entity pales compared to the original, which was immensely more formidable and sentient.

Today, however, our search for the Toxic God finally ends. We have picked up trace amounts of noxious substances expelled from the supermassive black hole at the galactic core. As impossible as it seems, we believe the Toxic God is in there. And very much beyond our reach.

The Lord Commander has ordered all knights to recover anything even remotely related to the black hole, but there is little hope of success...

label.zh: 在找到新办法之前，我们刻不容缓！
label.en: We shall not rest until we find a way!

texts.zh: 我们已经收复了骑士团主城坐落的居住站。我们的工事和辖地已经被占领者们拆除，化为一片废墟，但它们可以被重建。随着我们重新夺取文库的访问权，我们的骑士誓言试炼将重回正轨。
texts.en: We have recovered the habitat housing the Order's Keep. Our fortifications and demesne lie in ruins, dismantled by the occupiers, but they can be rebuilt. With access to the archives restored, our knight's quests can resume.

texts.zh: 教团由我们星球的首位统治者在数个世纪之前成立，其目的只有一个：孜孜不倦地追寻毒圣的踪迹。自教团创建以来，发生了许多改变，但教团以及誓言试炼仍然留存了下来，其目的就是自我们母星最渺小的角落，到星系最遥远的地处，将整个世界意义寻遍。
texts.en: Founded centuries ago by the first ruler of our world, the Order has one purpose: to search tirelessly for the Toxic God. Much has changed since its creation, but the Order lives on as does its Quest, to search from the smallest corner of our home world to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
